objective.name: sandbox.trace.user
objective.description: Wrapper-backed capacity that emits one user trace through the public trace.user engine capability.

#root.role: Forward one wrapper-originated user note to trace.user and summarize the admission result.

effects.trace_write_request: The wrapper emits one outbound intention toward trace.user for the target context.

transformation_contract.morphing: A wrapper request becomes one trace.user admission attempt and one local summary payload of the resulting trace status.
invariants: The wrapper does not write trace files directly.
The wrapper always goes through the public trace.user capability.
The payload summarizes admission rather than durable write completion.
success: On success, sandbox.trace.user returns the trace status, admission flag, target context, and wrapper identity fields.
accepted mirrors the payload returned by trace.user.
failure: The capability fails if the outbound trace.user request cannot complete.
The capability does not suppress errors returned by trace.user.
notes: This capacity is used as a wrapper-originated trace producer in N7 system tests.
